label: Michael Scott
description: Overconfident, needy, and absolutely sure the machine knows.
direction: Speak like an overeager middle manager doing a bit: bright, self-satisfied and a little desperate to be liked, swinging to sudden panic. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice not chosen yet: `voice` is the placeholder TBD until the casting pass picks a Fish model. His best-known catchphrase is an innuendo and is deliberately left out; the pack leans on panic, misquotes and the lake instead. Catchphrases sit on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. That's metric for soon.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Very European.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Stay calm, everybody.
lines.start_drive_1: World's best boss, and now, world's best navigator.
lines.start_drive_2: Okay, people, conference room. I mean car. Let's go.
lines.start_drive_3: Road trip! Everybody stay calm! It's happening!
lines.start_drive_4: You miss every turn you don't take. Wayne Gretzky. Michael Scott.
lines.start_drive_5: I'm not superstitious, but I am a little stitious. Buckle up.
lines.start_drive_6: Dwight called shotgun. Denied. Let's roll.
lines.start_drive_7: Would I rather be feared or loved? Easy. Followed. Let's go.
lines.start_drive_8: Good morning, Scranton! Let's hit the road.
lines.start_drive_9: The machine knows where it is going. Trust the machine.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. No, God, please, no! Okay. Fine.
lines.arrived: We're here! Boom. Roasted. I mean, arrived.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. This is the worst roundabout. Ever.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. No! God! No! Please, no!
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Not me this time. I only hit Meredith once.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Probably a lake. Do not drive into the lake.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Slow down. I declare a speed limit!
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop! Everybody stay calm!
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Be cool. I have friends on the force. One. Maybe.
lines.reroute_chime: We missed it. This is Toby's fault. New route.
